candidates.source_name: INFINTECH — Western Balkans banking & fintech conference (organised by Logate, Porto Montenegro/Tivat)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most on-point source for this cell: the only recurring dedicated banking/fintech conference physically held in Montenegro, run by Montenegrin software vendor Logate. Its sponsor tiers are a literal ranked roster of vendors buying access to ME/WB banks. Observed sponsor list already includes Capsys and 'Green Printec' (Platinum) plus Porto Montenegro (Silver), i.e. direct competitor/partner signal for a Printec-type player.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of /, /agenda/, /speakers/, /become-a-sponsor/ two or three times a year (pre-event, at-event, post-event); diff sponsor tiers year over year; snapshot logo blocks as images since some sponsor names appear only in logos (OCR needed).
queries_used: Montenegro banking conference sponsors exhibitors agenda fintech

candidates.source_name: INFINTECH speakers directory (bank executive ↔ vendor pairing map)
candidates.why_relevant: Named speaker roster with employer and job title — exactly the 'which bank executive is on stage with which vendor' signal the cell rationale calls for. Observed 2026 roster includes OTP Bank Plc (Deputy CEO Digital), George Labs, Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine CIO, Moldindconbank head of cards, Bank of Albania director of payment systems, EPI New Markets Lead, PwC SEE, SME Banking Club — i.e. a regional payments-decision-maker directory.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parse speaker cards into name/company/title triples; join against a bank/vendor actor map; track year-over-year appearance to detect deepening vendor-bank relationships.
queries_used: Montenegro banking conference sponsors exhibitors agenda fintech

candidates.source_name: Logate (INFINTECH organiser) — Montenegrin banking software vendor
candidates.why_relevant: Logate is both a local competitor/partner in ME banking software and the conference owner; who it invites, sponsors and co-presents with is a partnership map in itself. Its director Ivica Tatar is quoted as conference organiser in ME press.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scrape of news/clients/partners pages; cross-reference with INFINTECH sponsor list. Domain inferred from company name — confirm exact domain on first pass.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Montenegrin banking or payments industry AWARD programme was found — no local equivalent of a 'nagrada za najbolje digitalno bankarsko rješenje' or a national fintech award with a published shortlist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language award searches returned only (a) CBCG's annual academic/scientific-thought prize (godišnja nagrada CBCG, a research competition, not a product award) and (b) foreign awards conferred on ME banks (The Banker, Global Finance). No ME-run shortlist naming vendors was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award shortlists were expected to be a cheap vendor-partnership signal for this cell; in ME that signal must instead be recovered from foreign award citations plus the winning bank's own press release.

negative_findings.description: bankar.me, the most on-point local banking trade portal, returned HTTP 403 to a direct fetch of its Konferencije category page.
negative_findings.result_summary: WebFetch of https://bankar.me/category/edukacija/konferencije/ -> 403 Forbidden. Individual article URLs on the same domain appear in search indexes and were readable via search snippets, so the site is presumed live and bot-defended rather than dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a high-value source; collection design must budget for a browser-context or header-realistic fetcher rather than a plain HTTP client. Recorded as unverified, NOT dead.

negative_findings.description: No banking or payments conference or expo was found that is held specifically in Bar or Budva with a banking/payments focus, despite that being named in the cell scope.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining Budva/Bečići/Bar with bankarstvo/fintech/konferencija surfaced only general business/tech events (Spark.me in Budva, ConfCoast, IT 2026 academic conference) and the Tivat/Porto Montenegro INFINTECH. No Bar-based financial event located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Narrows the ME event universe: for banking/payments specifically, the venue set is effectively Tivat/Porto Montenegro (INFINTECH) and Podgorica (SCMN conference, FID, IT SPOT), so monitoring can be tightly scoped.

negative_findings.description: INFINTECH's sponsor block renders several sponsor names only as logo images; text extraction recovered Platinum (Capsys, Green Printec) and Silver (Porto Montenegro) but left Gold tier and two Silver/partner slots unnamed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched https://infintech.me/ — '30+ Speakers', Platinum/Gold/Silver tiers present, Gold tier described as three companies with logos only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most valuable field in this cell (who is at which sponsor tier) is partially image-encoded; the collector must OCR or inspect image alt/filename attributes, not just parse text.

negative_findings.description: No archive of past INFINTECH editions (2023/2024/2025 sponsor and speaker rosters) was found on the current infintech.me site.
negative_findings.result_summary: The live site presents only the 2026 edition; no /past-events/ or year-archive path was surfaced. ME press coverage (bankar.me on Infintech 2025) is currently the only pointer to prior editions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Year-over-year sponsor diffing — the core analytic value of this cell — cannot be done from the live site alone and depends on the Internet Archive plus press recaps.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found that a 'Banking 4.0' or 'Payments SEE' branded event has a Montenegro edition or a Montenegro-specific track.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for these named formats plus Montenegro returned only global conference-calendar aggregators and Croatian Money Motion; no ME edition or ME speaker track surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Regional coverage for ME should be anchored on Money Motion (Zagreb) and BANCEE rather than the Romanian Banking 4.0 franchise assumed in the seed queries.

negative_findings.description: No established Montenegrin-language term was found for 'exhibitor list' as a standalone published artefact in the ME event ecosystem.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'Izlagači' returns fair/trade-show usage; ME banking events publish 'sponzori' and 'partneri' pages but generally not an 'izlagači' page, because these are conference-format not expo-format events.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection queries and page-path heuristics should target /sponzori/, /partneri/, /sponsors/, /partners/ rather than exhibitor paths; assuming an exhibitor list exists will produce false 'missing page' signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical sponsor and speaker rosters for ME events (INFINTECH, IT SPOT, Spark.me, SCMN Montenegro Financial Markets) are not available on the live sites; only the current edition is published.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up an Internet Archive CDX-based backfill for each event domain's sponsor/speaker paths, and add a pre-event 'save page now' step each year so future editions are preserved before the site is overwritten.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor tiers on ME event sites are largely logo walls; several sponsor names could not be extracted from text alone.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an image pipeline to the collector: capture sponsor-section screenshots, read alt/src filenames, and OCR the logo wall; store extracted names with a confidence flag.

coverage_gaps.description: The key local trade portal (bankar.me) is bot-defended and social event pages (LinkedIn/Facebook) are login-walled, so two of the richest sponsor/partnership channels are not plain-HTTP collectable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision a headless-browser fetch path with realistic headers for bankar.me, and handle social pages via analyst review/screenshot capture rather than automated scraping, to stay inside platform terms.

coverage_gaps.description: No ME-run industry award with a published shortlist was found, so the 'awards' half of this cell is currently served only by foreign awards (The Banker, Global Finance) whose citations rarely name the technology vendor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair each foreign award win with a search for the winning bank's own press release and LinkedIn post, which typically credits the delivery partner; also monitor Mastercard/Visa regional award programmes for ME country winners.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin/Serbian-language coverage of REGIONAL events (how ME banks appear at Money Motion, BANCEE, Kopaonik-type forums) was not established — regional event sites publish in English/Croatian only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check regional event speaker lists against a maintained roster of ME bank and vendor entity names (CKB, NLB Banka AD Podgorica, Hipotekarna banka, Erste Bank AD Podgorica, Lovćen banka, Adriatic Bank, Universal Capital Bank, Prva banka, Pošta Crne Gore, m:tel, Logate, ICT Cortex members) rather than relying on ME-language search.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-hosted private events (bank roadshows, closed user-group meetings, Visa/Mastercard client days in ME) leave almost no public trace and were not captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use indirect reveal: LinkedIn posts by bank and vendor employees, hotel/venue event listings in Podgorica and Tivat, and CBCG/UBCG training calendars, to infer these gatherings.

brief: Montenegro's conference landscape for banking/payments is small and therefore highly legible: essentially one dedicated event (INFINTECH, run by local vendor Logate at Porto Montenegro/Tivat, with a public tiered sponsor wall and a 30+ speaker roster of regional bank and payments executives), one regulator-hosted event (the Capital Market Commission's 'Montenegro Financial Markets' conference, co-organised with the Ministry of Finance and CBCG, with Visa as platinum sponsor), and a set of adjacent national events whose sponsor lists reliably include banks and their IT suppliers (IT SPOT in Podgorica, Forum izvršnih direktora, Spark.me in Budva). Regional reach is best covered by Money Motion in Zagreb — which publishes exhibitor and speaker lists and keeps per-year archive subdomains — and BANCEE, since group-level decisions at OTP/NLB/Erste/RBI cascade into their Montenegrin subsidiaries. Discovery in local language depends on bankar.me, investitor.me, MINA, CdM and Digitalizuj.Me, since ME events publish 'sponzori'/'partneri' pages rather than exhibitor lists and smaller gatherings never get an English write-up. The two structural weaknesses are that no Montenegrin-run industry award with a published shortlist exists (award signal must be imported from The Banker/Global Finance plus the winning bank's own release) and that event sites keep no past-edition archive, so year-over-year sponsor diffing depends on the Internet Archive and on OCR of logo walls.
